name: WdTwoLinesInOneType
description: Specifies the character to use to enclose two lines being written into one.

constants.name: wdTwoLinesInOneNone
constants.description: Restore the two lines of text written into one to two separate lines.

constants.name: wdTwoLinesInOneSquareBrackets
constants.description: Enclose the lines using square brackets.

constants.name: wdTwoLinesInOneAngleBrackets
constants.description: Enclose the lines using angle brackets.

constants.name: wdTwoLinesInOneCurlyBrackets
constants.description: Enclose the lines using curly brackets.
